sentences.text: Tagarosuchus is an extinct genus of crocodyliform belonging to the protosuchian grade from the Early Cretaceous period.
The genus Tagarosuchus was named in 1999, with Tagarosuchus kulemzini designated as the type species.

Tagarosuchus coexisted with a diverse assemblage including various lizards, the crocodyliform Kyasuchus, the cynodont Xenocretosuchus, the mammal Gobiconodon, the dinosaur Psittacosaurus, troodontid theropods, and sauropods.
Tagarosuchus is classified within the parent group Protosuchia.
Tagarosuchus lived during the Barremian to Aptian stages, approximately 125.77 to 113.2 million years ago.
Remains of Tagarosuchus have been recovered from the Aptian-Albian Ilek Formation.
